ports.name: i_cmd_valid
ports.meaning: Command stream valid. The environment keeps it 0 while i_rst_n = 0

ports.name: o_cmd_ready
ports.meaning: Command stream ready. Does not depend combinationally on any input

ports.name: i_cmd_data
ports.meaning: Byte to send. Captured at the command handshake

ports.name: i_cmd_last
ports.meaning: 1 = this byte ends the burst, and o_cs_n is released after it. Captured at the command handshake

ports.name: o_rsp_data
ports.meaning: Byte received during the transfer of the matching command

ports.name: o_sclk
ports.type: Data (SPI serial clock; not used as a clock inside the block)

ports.name: i_miso
ports.meaning: SPI master-in slave-out data. Sampled by i_clk without a synchroniser

ports.name: i_cpol
ports.meaning: SPI clock polarity (SCLK idle level). May change only while o_cs_n = 1

ports.name: i_cpha
ports.meaning: SPI clock phase. 0 = sample on leading edges, 1 = sample on trailing edges. May change only while o_cs_n = 1

checks.title: o_cmd_ready changes only at clock edges or reset assertion
checks.behavior: Any change of o_cmd_ready occurs only in the time step of a rising edge of i_clk or of a 1->0 transition of i_rst_n. Changes of i_cmd_valid, i_cmd_data, i_cmd_last, i_rsp_ready, i_miso, i_cpol or i_cpha between rising edges never change o_cmd_ready.

checks.title: o_cmd_ready low while a response is shown
checks.behavior: At every rising edge of i_clk with i_rst_n=1: if o_rsp_valid=1 in the cycle ending at that edge, then o_cmd_ready=0 in that same cycle.

checks.title: o_cmd_ready in Idle after o_cs_n rise (blocked D-1 cycles)
checks.behavior: Let R be a rising edge at which o_cs_n changes 0->1 with i_rst_n=1 and D=PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV. In each cycle starting at edge R+i for i=0..D-2, o_cmd_ready=0 (no such cycle when D=1). In every cycle starting at edge R+D-1 or later, up to and including the cycle ending at the next command handshake, while i_rst_n=1: o_cmd_ready = NOT o_rsp_valid (for D=1 this holds from the cycle starting at R).

checks.title: o_cmd_ready during a transfer and in its last cycle
checks.behavior: For a command handshake at rising edge A (i_rst_n=1, i_cmd_valid=1, o_cmd_ready=1 in the cycle ending at A) with captured last=i_cmd_last at A: in every cycle starting at edges A..A+16*D-2, o_cmd_ready=0; in the cycle starting at edge A+16*D-1 (last cycle of the transfer), o_cmd_ready=1 if last=0 and o_rsp_valid=0 in that cycle, else o_cmd_ready=0. Hence no handshake occurs at edges A+1..A+16*D-1, and none at A+16*D when o_rsp_valid=1 in the last cycle.

checks.title: o_cmd_ready in Pause and Trail
checks.behavior: Pause = cycles starting at edge A+16*D or later of a transfer with captured last=0 when no handshake occurred at A+16*D, up to the cycle ending at the next handshake. In every Pause cycle with i_rst_n=1, o_cmd_ready = NOT o_rsp_valid. Trail = cycles starting at edges A+16*D..A+17*D-1 of a transfer with captured last=1; in every Trail cycle o_cmd_ready=0.

checks.title: o_cs_n falls exactly at a burst-start handshake
checks.behavior: At a rising edge E with i_rst_n=1: o_cs_n changes 1->0 at E if and only if in the cycle ending at E i_cmd_valid=1, o_cmd_ready=1 and o_cs_n=1. That edge is the burst-start acceptance edge A; the model captures CPOL_b=i_cpol and CPHA_b=i_cpha from the cycle ending at A.

checks.title: o_cs_n low for whole burst, rises at A_last+17D only
checks.behavior: After a burst start at edge A0, with i_rst_n=1 throughout, o_cs_n=0 in every cycle up to the cycle ending at edge A_L+17*D, where A_L is the handshake edge of the first transfer of the burst whose captured i_cmd_last=1; o_cs_n=1 in the cycle starting at A_L+17*D. o_cs_n changes at no other rising edge, never between rising edges except at a 1->0 transition of i_rst_n, and this holds whatever o_rsp_valid and i_rsp_ready are. For an n-byte burst with no Pause, o_cs_n is low for exactly 16*n*D+D cycles.

checks.title: Minimum o_cs_n high gap between bursts
checks.behavior: If o_cs_n changes 0->1 at edge R and i_rst_n stays 1 until the next 1->0 change of o_cs_n at edge F, then F >= R+D (o_cs_n=1 in every cycle starting at R..R+D-1). Not applied when i_rst_n goes to 0 between R and F.

checks.title: Lead time: first SCLK edge D cycles after o_cs_n falls
checks.behavior: For a burst start at edge A: in every cycle starting at edges A..A+D-1, o_cs_n=0 and o_sclk=CPOL_b; o_sclk changes to NOT CPOL_b at edge A+D. For any handshake at A (burst start, Pause, or joint), SCLK edge 1 of that transfer is at A+D.

checks.title: Pause entry and Pause outputs
checks.behavior: If a transfer with captured last=0 ends at edge A+16*D with no command handshake at that edge, then from the cycle starting at A+16*D until the next handshake edge P (i_rst_n=1): o_cs_n=0, o_sclk=CPOL_b, o_mosi keeps its value of the cycle starting at A+16*D, and o_sclk does not toggle; there is no timeout.

checks.title: MOSI shift timing, CPHA_b=0
checks.behavior: For a transfer with handshake edge A, captured d=i_cmd_data at A and CPHA_b=0: o_mosi=d[7] in the cycle starting at A; o_mosi=d[7-j] in the cycle starting at A+2*j*D for j=1..7, constant in between; after A+16*D o_mosi keeps d[0] unless a handshake occurs at A+16*D, in which case it equals the new d[7] from that edge.

checks.title: MOSI shift timing, CPHA_b=1
checks.behavior: For a transfer with handshake edge A, captured d and CPHA_b=1: in the cycles starting at A..A+D-1, o_mosi equals its value in the cycle ending at A; o_mosi=d[7-j] in the cycle starting at A+(2*j+1)*D for j=0..7, constant in between.

checks.title: o_mosi changes only at shift edges; holds in Idle/Pause/Trail
checks.behavior: o_mosi changes only at the rising edges listed in CHK-011/CHK-012 or at a 1->0 transition of i_rst_n; it never changes between rising edges otherwise. In Idle, Pause and Trail cycles o_mosi equals its value in the previous cycle; after reset release and before the first shift edge o_mosi=0.

checks.title: o_mosi stable at every sampling edge
checks.behavior: Sampling edges of a transfer with handshake A: S=A+(2*j+1)*D if CPHA_b=0, S=A+(2*j+2)*D if CPHA_b=1, j=0..7. At each S, o_mosi in the cycle ending at S equals o_mosi in the cycle starting at S and equals d[7-j].

checks.title: Outputs take reset values at once on i_rst_n assertion
checks.behavior: On every 1->0 transition of i_rst_n, in the same time step (after combinational settling) and before any further rising edge of i_clk: o_cs_n=1, o_mosi=0, o_rsp_valid=0, o_rsp_data=8'h00, o_cmd_ready=1 and o_sclk=i_cpol. This holds whatever phase the DUT was in (transfer, mid SCLK half period, Pause, Trail, Idle gap, shown/held byte).

checks.title: Output values held while in reset
checks.behavior: While i_rst_n=0 (checked at every rising and falling edge of i_clk), o_cs_n=1, o_mosi=0, o_rsp_valid=0, o_rsp_data=8'h00 and o_cmd_ready=1, whatever the values of i_cmd_valid, i_cmd_data, i_cmd_last, i_rsp_ready, i_miso and i_cpha.

checks.title: o_sclk follows i_cpol combinationally during reset
checks.behavior: While i_rst_n=0: at every rising and falling edge of i_clk and in the same time step as every change of i_cpol (no clock edge needed), o_sclk equals the current value of i_cpol.

checks.title: Ready to accept at first edge after reset release
checks.behavior: Let E be the first rising edge of i_clk with i_rst_n=1 after a period with i_rst_n=0. In the cycle ending at E: o_cmd_ready=1, o_cs_n=1, o_rsp_valid=0. o_cmd_ready stays 1 in every following cycle until the first command handshake (i_rst_n=1, i_cmd_valid=1, o_cmd_ready=1 at a rising edge). No minimum o_cs_n high time is required: a handshake at E is legal and makes o_cs_n=0 after E.

checks.title: Response outputs change only at clock edges or reset
checks.behavior: Any change of o_rsp_valid or o_rsp_data occurs only in the time step of a rising edge of i_clk or of a 1->0 transition of i_rst_n.

checks.title: Response reference model: data, order, timing, depth<=2
checks.behavior: Model: for each transfer with handshake A, r[7-j] = i_miso in the cycle ending at A+(2*j+1)*D (CPHA_b=0) or A+(2*j+2)*D (CPHA_b=1), j=0..7. Queue Q cleared on i_rst_n=0. At each rising edge E with i_rst_n=1: first, if o_rsp_valid=1 and i_rsp_ready=1 in the cycle ending at E, pop the head; then, if E=A+16*D of a transfer, push r. In the cycle starting at E: o_rsp_valid=1 iff Q is non-empty, o_rsp_data equals head(Q) when non-empty, and |Q|<=2 always. (Covers: load at A+16*D in all modes, held byte, held byte promoted at handshake, valid drop, no overwrite, no duplication, order.)

checks.title: o_rsp_data hold and i_rsp_ready ignored while not valid
checks.behavior: At a rising edge E with i_rst_n=1 that is not an edge A+16*D of a transfer: if o_rsp_valid=0 in the cycle ending at E, then in the cycle starting at E o_rsp_valid=0 and o_rsp_data is unchanged, whatever i_rsp_ready is. If o_rsp_valid=1 and i_rsp_ready=0 in the cycle ending at E, then o_rsp_valid=1 and o_rsp_data unchanged after E.

checks.title: No transfer starts while a byte is shown or held
checks.behavior: At every command handshake edge E (i_rst_n=1, i_cmd_valid=1, o_cmd_ready=1 in the cycle ending at E), o_rsp_valid=0 in the cycle ending at E and the CHK-020 queue is empty before the push at E. Consequently no o_sclk toggle sequence of a new transfer starts while a byte is shown or held.

checks.title: SCLK edges at A+k*D with correct levels
checks.behavior: For each transfer with handshake edge A and burst value CPOL_b, for k=1..16: o_sclk in the cycle starting at edge A+k*D differs from o_sclk in the cycle ending at A+k*D, and equals NOT CPOL_b for odd k and CPOL_b for even k; o_sclk is constant between those edges, so every SCLK half period is exactly D cycles and the transfer spans 16*D cycles.

checks.title: No other o_sclk changes while o_cs_n=0
checks.behavior: While o_cs_n=0 both before and after a rising edge E (i_rst_n=1), o_sclk may change at E only if E=A+k*D for an active transfer with k in 1..16. While o_cs_n=0, o_sclk never changes between rising edges of i_clk, including when i_cpol or i_cpha change.

checks.title: SCLK at CPOL_b in lead, Pause and Trail
checks.behavior: In every cycle with o_cs_n=0 that is not between SCLK edge 1 and SCLK edge 16 of a transfer (cycles starting at A..A+D-1 of a burst start, Pause cycles, Trail cycles A_L+16*D..A_L+17*D-1), o_sclk=CPOL_b.

checks.title: o_sclk equals i_cpol while o_cs_n=1
checks.behavior: Whenever o_cs_n=1 (checked at every rising and falling edge of i_clk and in the same time step as every change of i_cpol), o_sclk equals the current i_cpol. In particular in the cycle starting at edge R where o_cs_n rises, o_sclk = i_cpol even if i_cpol differs from CPOL_b.

checks.title: No-gap joint between back-to-back transfers
checks.behavior: If a handshake occurs at edge A_p+16*D of a transfer with captured last=0 (new A=A_p+16*D), then o_cs_n stays 0, o_sclk toggles to CPOL_b at A_p+16*D and toggles to NOT CPOL_b at A_p+17*D (SCLK edge 1 of the new transfer); the interval between any two consecutive o_sclk toggles across the joint is exactly D cycles.

checks.title: Commands without handshake have no effect
checks.behavior: Only handshaken commands, with values at the handshake edge, are acted on.
checks.stimulus: (a) Error: i_cmd_valid=1 with random i_cmd_data/i_cmd_last during reset (o_cmd_ready=1), i_cmd_valid=0 at release. (b) i_cmd_valid=1 while o_cmd_ready=0 (transfer, Trail, Idle gap, o_rsp_valid=1) with i_cmd_data/i_cmd_last changed every cycle until the handshake. (c) i_cmd_valid pulsed 1 then withdrawn while o_cmd_ready=0. (d) random i_cmd_data/i_cmd_last with i_cmd_valid=0.
checks.expected: (a) o_cs_n stays 1 and no SCLK/response until a handshake with i_rst_n=1. (b) the transferred byte and burst end are exactly i_cmd_data/i_cmd_last of the handshake edge. (c),(d) no o_cs_n change, no SCLK toggle, no response; response count equals handshake count.

checks.title: No combinational input paths to registered outputs
checks.behavior: Inputs toggled between edges never change o_cmd_ready, o_rsp_valid, o_rsp_data, o_cs_n, o_mosi.
checks.stimulus: In Idle, Idle gap, transfer, last transfer cycle, Pause and Trail, with o_rsp_valid 0 and 1: toggle i_cmd_valid, i_cmd_data, i_cmd_last, i_rsp_ready, i_miso and i_cpha at the falling edge and at 3/4 of the i_clk period (restoring before the rising edge where a handshake is not wanted); i_cpol toggled only while o_cs_n=1.
checks.expected: o_cmd_ready, o_rsp_valid, o_rsp_data, o_cs_n and o_mosi do not change between rising edges; o_sclk changes between edges only while o_cs_n=1, following i_cpol.

checks.title: i_cmd_last=1 on first byte; o_cs_n rise independent of response stream
checks.behavior: Single-byte bursts with and without back-pressure.
checks.stimulus: Each mode: commands all with i_cmd_last=1, i_cmd_valid=1 continuously; first with i_rsp_ready=1, then with i_rsp_ready=0 for 4*16*D cycles after a response becomes valid, then i_rsp_ready=1 for one cycle at edge H.
checks.expected: o_cs_n low exactly 17*D cycles per byte. With i_rsp_ready=0, o_cs_n still rises at A+17*D while o_rsp_valid=1; o_cmd_ready=0 and no burst starts until handshake H; o_cmd_ready=1 in the cycle starting at H (H>=R+D-1) and the next burst is accepted at H+1. Coverage: i_cmd_last=1 on first byte.

checks.title: Pause entry/exit, long pause and endless burst
checks.behavior: Command gaps inside a burst produce Pause with held outputs, no timeout, and correct restart.
checks.stimulus: Each mode, i_rsp_ready=1: burst with i_cmd_last=0 where i_cmd_valid drops for 1 cycle, for many cycles (e.g. 2*16*D) and for a very long time (e.g. 20*16*D) between commands; a burst of >=16 commands (CFG-MAX: 2) all with i_cmd_last=0 then no further command until end of test.
checks.expected: After each non-last transfer ending at A+16*D without handshake: o_cs_n=0, o_sclk=CPOL_b, o_mosi unchanged, o_cmd_ready=1 for the whole gap; a handshake at P starts a transfer with SCLK edge 1 at P+D, in the same burst (o_cs_n stays 0) with the same CPOL_b/CPHA_b; 1-cycle gap gives handshake at A+16*D+1. With i_cmd_last=0 forever o_cs_n stays 0 to end of simulation. Coverage hit: pause entry and exit.

checks.title: Mode captured at burst start (change just before acceptance)
checks.behavior: New i_cpol/i_cpha presented in the cycle before a burst-start handshake are the ones used.
checks.stimulus: For all 12 ordered pairs of distinct modes X->Y: in Idle with mode X, change i_cpol/i_cpha to Y at the falling edge just before the burst-start acceptance edge A while presenting the command; slave model configured for Y; 2-byte burst (with a pause between bytes).
checks.expected: o_sclk equals Y's i_cpol in Idle immediately, then CPOL_b=Y.cpol from A; SCLK edges and levels, MOSI shift edges and MISO sampling follow Y for both transfers including Pause and Trail; MOSI monitor and responses correct.

checks.title: Error test: mode inputs changed during a burst are ignored
checks.behavior: Deliberate ENV-003 violation: i_cpol/i_cpha change while o_cs_n=0.
checks.stimulus: Each mode M: 2-byte burst with a Pause between bytes; complement i_cpol and i_cpha in the middle of transfer 1 (between SCLK edges), again during the Pause and again during the Trail; slave model stays in M. Compare with a reference run of the same traffic without the changes.
checks.expected: o_sclk, o_mosi and o_cs_n waveforms while o_cs_n=0 are identical to the reference run (CPOL_b/CPHA_b of M); responses equal slave bytes. At the edge R where o_cs_n rises, o_sclk takes the current i_cpol (differs from CPOL_b) at R and follows i_cpol combinationally afterwards. No error is reported.

checks.title: i_cpol toggled in reset and Idle
checks.behavior: o_sclk follows i_cpol combinationally whenever o_cs_n=1.
checks.stimulus: Toggle i_cpol several times while i_rst_n=0 at times between clock edges (e.g. quarter period after a rising edge), and in Idle with i_rst_n=1 (including during the D-cycle Idle gap after a burst), i_cmd_valid=0.
checks.expected: After every i_cpol change o_sclk equals the new i_cpol in the same time step, without a clock edge; o_cs_n stays 1, no acceptance.

checks.title: Reset in each phase: abort, discard, immediate restart
checks.behavior: Asynchronous reset at falling edges of i_clk in every phase, then restart.
checks.stimulus: Assert i_rst_n=0 at a falling edge of i_clk (a) in a transfer in mid SCLK half period (D>=2) and just after an SCLK edge, (b) in Pause, (c) in Trail, (d) in the Idle gap, (e) with a shown byte (i_rsp_ready=0), (f) with a shown and a held byte. Hold >=2 cycles with i_cmd_valid=0, release at a falling edge, present a new command for the first rising edge with i_rst_n=1; i_rsp_ready=1 after release.
checks.expected: In the same time step as assertion: o_cs_n=1, o_sclk=i_cpol, o_mosi=0, o_rsp_valid=0, o_rsp_data=8'h00, o_cmd_ready=1. After release o_rsp_valid stays 0 until A_new+16*D: no response of the aborted transfer and no discarded shown/held byte appears. The new command is accepted at the first rising edge with i_rst_n=1 (o_cs_n falls there, even if o_cs_n was high for fewer than D cycles); the first response equals the new transfer's slave byte. Coverage: reset in each phase.

checks.title: Back-pressure: held byte created and released; consumer never takes
checks.behavior: Long i_rsp_ready=0 creates a held byte; no transfer starts and no byte is lost or duplicated.
checks.stimulus: Each mode: i_rsp_ready=0; i_cmd_valid=1 continuously with cmd1(last=0), cmd2(last=0), cmd3 (CFG-MAX: cmd2 last=1 and cmd3 starts a new burst). Hold i_rsp_ready=0 for a long window (e.g. 10*16*D cycles) after cmd2 ends, then i_rsp_ready=1 for exactly one cycle, wait, then one more single-cycle i_rsp_ready=1. Variant: cmd2 with i_cmd_last=1. Variant: i_rsp_ready=0 until end of simulation.
checks.expected: cmd2 accepted at A1+16*D; o_rsp_valid=1 with r1 from A1+16*D, o_cmd_ready=0. At A2+16*D r2 becomes held: o_rsp_valid=1, o_rsp_data=r1 unchanged, Pause (o_cs_n=0, no SCLK toggle, cmd3 not accepted) for the whole window. First handshake: o_rsp_data=r2, o_rsp_valid stays 1, o_cmd_ready=0. Second handshake at H: o_rsp_valid=0, o_cmd_ready=1 in cycle starting at H, cmd3 accepted at H+1. Last=1 variant: o_cs_n rises at A2+17D regardless of shown/held bytes, Trail entered, no new burst until both bytes taken. Never-take variant: o_rsp_valid=1 with r1 to end, no further SCLK toggle. Coverage: held byte created and released.

checks.title: Response handshake exactly at A+16D and random i_rsp_ready
checks.behavior: A handshake coinciding with the end of a transfer loads the new byte directly; random ready patterns never lose data.
checks.stimulus: Each mode: two-byte continuous burst; i_rsp_ready=0 while r1 is shown, then i_rsp_ready=1 only in the cycle ending at edge A2+16*D. Then long random traffic with i_rsp_ready random each cycle (e.g. 10%, 50%, 90% duty).
checks.expected: At A2+16*D: o_rsp_valid stays 1 and o_rsp_data changes from r1 to r2 (no held byte); since o_rsp_valid=1 in the last cycle, o_cmd_ready was 0 and the burst enters Pause (or Trail). Random run: scoreboard shows every response equal to its slave byte, in order, no loss/duplication.

checks.title: All four modes with random data, burst lengths and gaps
checks.behavior: End-to-end random traffic in each SPI mode with slave model and scoreboard, run in every configuration (CFG-BASE, CFG-MIN, CFG-MAX).
checks.stimulus: i_rst_n=0 from time zero for >=2 cycles, released at a falling edge of i_clk, i_cmd_valid=0 during reset. For each mode (i_cpol,i_cpha) in {00,01,10,11}, changed only while o_cs_n=1: random i_cmd_data; bursts of length 1, 2 and >=16 (CFG-MAX: lengths 1 and 2 only, chosen by reading PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV) with i_cmd_last=1 only on the last byte; i_cmd_valid gaps of 0, 1 and many (e.g. 3*16*D) cycles between commands; i_rsp_ready=1. Slave model driven from o_sclk/o_cs_n only with random bytes: CPHA=0 puts bit 7 when o_cs_n falls and next bit after each trailing SCLK edge; CPHA=1 puts bit 7-j after leading SCLK edge 2*j+1; i_miso changes only after the i_clk edge at which o_sclk/o_cs_n changed.
checks.expected: Slave-side MOSI monitor receives exactly the accepted i_cmd_data bytes, MSB first, in acceptance order. Number of response handshakes equals number of command handshakes; each o_rsp_data at handshake equals the byte the slave sent during the matching transfer, in order, with no loss or duplicate. Coverage records all four modes in the configuration, burst lengths 1/2/>=16 (1/2 in CFG-MAX) and gaps 0/1/many. All assertions CHK-001..CHK-027 pass.

checks.title: MISO sampling-edge precision
checks.behavior: Prove i_miso is captured only in the single cycle ending at each sampling edge and has no effect elsewhere.
checks.stimulus: For each mode, single-byte and 2-byte bursts with i_rsp_ready=1 and random expected byte r. Testbench drives i_miso = r[7-j] only in the one cycle ending at the sampling edge A+(2*j+1)*D (CPHA=0) or A+(2*j+2)*D (CPHA=1), changing i_miso at falling edges of i_clk, and drives NOT r[7-j] (or random) in every other cycle, including lead, Pause, Trail, Idle and the other cycles of each half period.
checks.expected: Each response o_rsp_data equals r of its own transfer exactly (no bit from the cycle before or after a sampling edge, no bit from a previous transfer). Repeated with i_miso = complement pattern gives ~r.

checks.title: Continuous bursts, joint timing and throughput
checks.behavior: Back-to-back commands with the response drained in time give gapless SCLK and the specified latencies.
checks.stimulus: Each mode: i_cmd_valid held 1 with the next command always presented, i_rsp_ready=1; bursts of n=16 (CFG-MAX n=2) followed immediately by another burst; then a sequence of single-byte bursts (i_cmd_last=1 always). Boundary variant: i_rsp_ready=0 except in the one cycle ending at edge V+16*D-1 where V is the edge at which o_rsp_valid became 1 (continuous expected), and second variant with that single cycle ending at V+16*D (pause expected).
checks.expected: Acceptance edges at A1+16*i*D, i=0..n-1; o_sclk toggles every D cycles from A1+D to A1+16*n*D (16*n toggles, no gap); o_cs_n low for exactly 16*n*D+D cycles; next burst first acceptance at A1+16*n*D+2*D (o_cs_n high exactly D cycles); single-byte burst period exactly 18*D cycles. Boundary variant 1: next transfer starts at A2+16*D with no SCLK pause; variant 2: o_cmd_ready=0 in last cycle, Pause entered, no handshake at A2+16*D. Coverage hit: continuous join.

checks.title: Divider timing in the configuration (incl. D=1 and D=255)
checks.behavior: SCLK half period equals PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV in the simulated configuration.
checks.stimulus: Each mode, bursts of 1 and 2 bytes, i_cmd_data 8'hA5 and 8'h5A, random slave bytes, i_rsp_ready=1.
checks.expected: Every interval between consecutive o_sclk toggles within a burst is PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV cycles (SCLK period 2*PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV), a byte takes 16*PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV cycles (16 for CFG-MIN, 64 for CFG-BASE, 4080 for CFG-MAX with all 16 toggles at A+k*255, no counter overflow), data correct.

not_verified.note: Elaboration error for illegal PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV; checked by one elaboration with an illegal value, not by simulation.
Explicitly an elaboration check of REQ-PAR-001.
Same as REQ-PAR-001 elaboration error.
Parameter sweep 1..255; spot-covered by running all checks in CFG-MIN, CFG-BASE, CFG-MAX.
Clocking structure of state elements; lint/synthesis check.
o_sclk as data output is structural; its timing is checked by CHK-023/CHK-024.
o_sclk not used as clock: structural.
No synchroniser on i_miso: structural; the resulting single-cycle sampling is checked by CHK-039.
Silicon setup/hold of i_miso; STA/board constraint.
Timing closure at 50 MHz, GF180MCU ss_125C_4v50; synthesis flow.
RTL coding rules; lint.
Flip-flop clock/reset style; structural.
No latches, clock gating, derived clocks; lint/synthesis.
o_cs_n/o_mosi driven directly by flops; structural (glitch-free behaviour observed by CHK-007/CHK-013).
o_sclk from flop while o_cs_n=0; structural (observable effect in CHK-024).
Only i_cpol combinational path to o_sclk; structural (observable effect in CHK-029).

assumptions: D denotes PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV. A command handshake (acceptance) at rising edge E means i_rst_n=1, i_cmd_valid=1 and o_cmd_ready=1 in the cycle ending at E; the checker captures i_cmd_data, i_cmd_last there, and if o_cs_n=1 in that cycle it is a burst start and CPOL_b=i_cpol, CPHA_b=i_cpha are captured from the same cycle.

'Cycle starting at edge E' means values observed after E has settled (sampled before the next rising edge, e.g. at the falling edge); 'cycle ending at E' means values sampled just before E. Testbench drives inputs at falling edges of i_clk unless a test says otherwise.

The interface-level checker models transfer phases (lead, transfer, Pause, Trail, Idle gap) and the expected received byte from i_miso at sampling edges using only port values and PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV; all checker state is cleared while i_rst_n=0.

Per the designer decision, i_rst_n is asserted and released at falling edges of i_clk; CFG-MAX tests use bursts of at most 2 bytes and long waits are expressed as multiples of 16*D, capped to keep run time bounded.
Coverage items of VER-011 are collected inside the listed tests; each test is run in each configuration CFG-BASE, CFG-MIN, CFG-MAX through run_set.json.

decisions.question: Do CFG-MIN and CFG-MAX also require full-length bursts, or only the short bursts stated for CFG-MAX?
decisions.answer: CFG-BASE and CFG-MIN run every burst length of VER-002 (1, 2 and at least 16). CFG-MAX runs bursts of 1 and 2 bytes only ('short' = at most 2 bytes) to bound simulation time; 16-byte bursts are covered in CFG-BASE and CFG-MIN. Tests read the parameter to choose.

decisions.question: ENV-007 says reset assertion happens between i_clk edges, but SPI-12-02 allows asynchronous assertion and VER-007 requires asserting between edges; how should simulation drive assertion between edges?
decisions.answer: Simulation asserts and releases i_rst_n at a falling edge of i_clk: half a period from every rising edge, so assertion is between edges (ENV-007, VER-007) and release is synchronous and stable before the next rising edge (ENV-001).

decisions.question: Which worst-case corner (PVT) is meant for timing closure?
decisions.answer: The slow corner used by the flow: GF180MCU 7-track ss, 125 C, 4.50 V (gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__ss_125C_4v50). The flow reports an ABC delay estimate at that corner; signoff STA is out of scope.
